svg.title: A burst on HTTP/1.1, default transport against 512 idle per host
svg.desc: A caller limited to one CPU, with a 100 ms deadline, sends 1,200 requests a second, 2,400 for 30 seconds from the 15th, then 1,200 again, over plain HTTP and over TLS. Successful requests, failed requests and caller throttling per second. One run of each.
